reviews.text: The cancellation and change policy is far too strict. I accidentally entered the wrong date and time for my reservation on the day of my appointment, and immediately requested a change, but they refused to accept it and I was forced to pay the full amount.

The hot water stopped working midway through, so I couldn't wash properly. Since it's just circulating cold water, it's the worst when you're washing at the same time as other people.

Paying 3000 yen and spending time washing there, only for the hot water to stop working, really makes you wonder what the point of going there was.
I'm so glad everything I need is here.
It's clean and easy to use.

This is a very clean and easy-to-use facility.
It's very helpful that it's open 24 hours a day.
I watched the video twice beforehand to prepare.
It was my first time using it and I was able to get my Shiba Inu in shedding season done in one hour without shampooing.
The microbubbles alone make him smooth and fluffy.
I'd need an hour and a half to shampoo him, but I don't think two hours is necessary.
I would definitely use it again, but I'm not sure about the time.
I minus one star because reservations are only available in one-hour increments. I give the facility 5 stars!
Using the facilities on weekends when staff are present is reassuring because they can explain the usage in detail.
The booths were private and the necessary equipment was efficiently arranged. The lack of parking was a problem, and some customers seemed to be forcing their cars to park in front of the store.

I also had my dog ​​trimmed on a day the groomer was there.
The owner was nearby and the dog was distracted, but the groomer still efficiently cut his dog's hair. I appreciated that they checked the cut right in front of me.
I also inquired about how to make a reservation via LINE, and they would let me know if I asked, as it's not just for shampooing.
I would definitely use their services again.
